description: Best practices for Spring Boot application development.

Use Maven (`pom.xml`) or Gradle (`build.gradle`) and Spring Boot starters. Organize code by feature/domain, not layer. Always use constructor-based injection for required dependencies; declare dependency fields `private final`. Use `<REDACTED_USER>`, `<REDACTED_USER>`, `<REDACTED_USER>`, and `<REDACTED_USER>`/`<REDACTED_USER>` annotations appropriately to define beans.

Configure with `application.yml` (or `application.properties`); use `<REDACTED_USER>` for type-safe properties and Spring Profiles (`application-dev.yml`, `application-prod.yml`) for environment-specific configuration. Do not hardcode secrets. Use environment variables or a dedicated secret management tool like HashiCorp Vault or AWS Secrets Manager.

Design consistent RESTful APIs. Use DTOs in the API layer. Do not expose JPA entities directly to the client. Use `<REDACTED_USER>` on service methods for declarative transactions, at the most granular level necessary.
